en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It was from the supplications of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> seek Refuge from a woman who ages me<sup>saww</sup> before my<sup>saww</sup> age’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that of the prayers of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, was this,
‘I seek refuge with You, O Lord, against a woman who makes me become old before my becoming old.’”
